title: JFK/UMass Station
content: JFK/UMass is a Red Line station in Dorchester, Boston. It is the closest Red Line station to UMass Boston campus. From JFK/UMass, students transfer to the UMass Boston shuttle, which runs every 5-10 minutes during the academic year. The walk from the campus shuttle drop-off at the Campus Center to most classroom buildings is about 3-5 minutes.

title: Park Street Station
content: Park Street is a transfer station between the Red Line and all Green Line branches in downtown Boston. Allow 2-3 minutes for transferring between platforms. Park Street is one of the busiest stations on the system.

title: Downtown Crossing Station
content: Downtown Crossing is a transfer station between the Red Line and Orange Line in downtown Boston. Allow 2-4 minutes for transferring between platforms.

title: State Station
content: State Street is a transfer station between the Orange Line and Blue Line in downtown Boston. Allow 3-5 minutes for transferring between platforms.

title: Government Center Station
content: Government Center is a transfer station between the Green Line and Blue Line. It is the northern terminus of Green Line C and E branches. Transfer takes about 2-3 minutes.

title: North Station
content: North Station is a transfer hub between the Orange Line, Green Line D and E branches, and Commuter Rail (Lowell, Haverhill, Newburyport/Rockport, Fitchburg lines). Transfer between subway platforms takes about 2-4 minutes; transfer to Commuter Rail above ground takes about 5-7 minutes.

title: South Station
content: South Station is a major transfer hub between the Red Line, all Silver Line branches, and Commuter Rail (Providence/Stoughton, Franklin, Needham, Greenbush, Middleborough, Fairmount lines). Allow 4-6 minutes to transfer between subway and Silver Line.

title: Kenmore Station
content: Kenmore is a Green Line station in the Fenway area, where the B, C, and D branches converge. Bus 8 (Harbor Point/UMass) terminates here, which is a common transfer point for UMass Boston students heading to the Boston University area.

title: Alewife Station
content: Alewife is the northern terminus of the Red Line in Cambridge. It includes a large parking garage and connections to several MBTA bus routes. From Alewife to JFK/UMass takes about 35 minutes by Red Line during off-peak.

title: Quincy Center Station
content: Quincy Center is a Red Line station on the Braintree branch. Quincy Center to JFK/UMass takes about 14 minutes off-peak.
